data.title: 金色暗影 · 旧书店木梯上的踮脚取书
data.description: 午后安静的街角旧书店里弥漫着纸页与木头香气，金色暗影穿着清爽的浅蓝牛仔背带短裤踩在低矮木踏凳上，踮起帆布鞋尖伸手去够高处书架的地球图鉴。阳光从高窗斜洒下来，在她的金发与明黄条纹衫上缀满轻尘微光。
data.location: 满墙木书架与高窗阳光的街角旧书店
data.action: 站在木踏凳上踮脚伸手取高处书架的厚书
data.lighting: 高窗斜射的暖金光线与书架间的静谧柔影
data.camera: 略低侧后四分之三全身，捕捉踮脚取书的轻盈动态
data.mood: 专注、纯朴、充满假日生活感
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet secondhand bookstore filled with tall timber shelves, Golden Darkness balances on a small wooden step stool and reaches up to pull a thick encyclopedia from an upper shelf. Warm afternoon sunbeams from a high window catch her golden hair and the brass clasps of her light-blue denim short overalls.
data.animaCaption: Balanced on a wooden step stool in the sunlit bookstore, she reaches up to draw a book from the high shelf.
